fixes: §2.5 DPOK: KL identity '=' corrected to '<=' between per-step trajectory-KL sum and the endpoint marginal KL DPOK actually wants to regularize, with a data-processing-inequality caveat (CONFIRMED)

§4.1.1 ELBO surrogate + boxed Diffusion-DPO loss + Q3 + Q21: added the omega(lambda_t) SNR-weight caveat (L_simple sets omega(lambda_t)=1, a deliberate Ho 2020 reweighting, not a tight ELBO identity) and inserted omega(lambda_t) into the boxed loss formula (CONFIRMED)

§4.1.2 paired-noise warning box + code comment + Q10: softened 'must share epsilon or beta incomparable / variance explodes' to 'shared noise is a variance-reduction (common random numbers) technique, not a correctness requirement — independent noise gives a valid higher-variance unbiased estimator' (CONFIRMED)

§6.2 docstring + beta-magnitude warning box + Q5: rephrased 'beta*T is the true temperature' as implementation-dependent (mean vs sum MSE reduction; DDPM 1000-step training schedule vs the tutorial's own 20-50-step inference schedule), not a portable universal fact (NEEDS_NUANCE)

§6.1 DDPO code: fixed a real NaN/Inf bug — the deterministic t=0 terminal transition (std=0 by Ho et al. 2020 convention) was fed directly into a division and .log() in the policy-gradient recompute and KL terms; added std.clamp(min=1e-6) guards, and a matching prose note in the implementation-footguns box (CONFIRMED)

§6.1 footgun box + Q7: corrected 'DDIM-eta=0 -> policy gradient equals 0' to 'REINFORCE/score-function estimators degenerate under deterministic transitions, but the true gradient of E[R] is not zero — x_0 remains a differentiable function of theta, so DRaFT/AlignProp's pathwise gradient still exists' (CONFIRMED)

§6.5 Flow-GRPO code: the 'first-step divide-by-zero' sub-claim was refuted (the existing sigma+1e-6 guard plus sigma^2 cancellation already prevents NaN/Inf) so it was NOT changed as a bug; instead sharpened the existing placeholder disclaimer and added a new note that sigma_fn(t)=sqrt(1-t) gives zero noise at the trajectory start (t=1) and maximal noise at the end (t=0) — backwards from the usual explore-early intuition (NEEDS_NUANCE)

§8 production-landscape table + §8.2 bullet + Q24: corrected 'DALL-E 3 explicitly used caption-faithful RLHF' to 'DALL-E 3's public report (Betker et al. 2023) is centered on synthetic recaptioning (data augmentation), and does not describe an RLHF post-training mechanism' (CONFIRMED)
